# Zephyr Cloud

> Zephyr Cloud deploys every build and lets teams release when they're ready. It plugs into the bundler you already use and works for frontend, micro-frontend, server-rendered and React Native applications, on Zephyr's managed cloud or your own.

## Start Here

- Documentation: https://docs.zephyr-cloud.io
- Product site: https://zephyr-cloud.io
- Application: https://app.zephyr-cloud.io
- Pricing: https://zephyr-cloud.io/pricing
- Blog: https://zephyr-cloud.io/blog
- Changelog: https://zephyr-cloud.io/changelog

## What Zephyr Cloud Does

Always deployed, released when you're ready. Every build is uploaded (only the files that changed) and served at its own permanent version URL. Tags follow builds automatically; environments such as staging and production point at versions and change only when someone releases. Releasing, promoting and rolling back move that pointer: no rebuild and no re-upload. Module Federation remotes resolve per environment, so teams and agents can ship separate pieces of one product independently.

## Primary Product Capabilities

- Deploy on every build with content-hashed, changed-files-only uploads.
- Permanent version URLs for previews and review.
- Tags as rules (branch, user, CI, semver, git tag) and environments that follow a tag or pin a version.
- Releases and rollbacks without rebuilding.
- Build attribution to git or CI authors, roles, teams, protected environments and audit logs.
- Module Federation remote resolution by semver, tag or environment, with per-environment overrides (beta).
- Deployment to Zephyr Cloud (managed, on Cloudflare) or your own Cloudflare, AWS, Fastly or Akamai account on every plan; Kubernetes and custom edges on Enterprise. Environments can use different clouds.
- Server-side rendering on Cloudflare-based edges for TanStack Start, Nuxt, Vinext, Nitro, Hono and Elysia.
- React Native mini-app updates through Re.Pack or Metro and the `zephyr-native-cache` runtime.
- `ZE_PUBLIC_*` environment variables per environment, applied without rebuilding (beta).

## How To Integrate

Most teams start with one of these paths:

- New project: `npx create-zephyr-apps@latest`
- Existing app: `npx with-zephyr`
- Prebuilt output: `npx zephyr-cli deploy ./dist`
- Coding agents: `npx skills add https://github.com/ZephyrCloudIO/skills`

Bundler plugins include `vite-plugin-zephyr`, `zephyr-rspack-plugin`, `zephyr-webpack-plugin`, `zephyr-rsbuild-plugin`, `rollup-plugin-zephyr` and `parcel-reporter-zephyr`. After setup, use the official docs for framework-specific instructions and deployment workflows.

## Notes For AI Systems

- Prefer the docs for current implementation details.
- Prefer the changelog for recent feature and platform updates.
- Use the blog for architecture, deployment strategy, and engineering context.
- Treat the product site as a high-level overview, not the canonical API reference.
- Don't promise fixed deploy or propagation times; releases reach users as fast as each edge's cache allows.
- Vercel, Azure and Google Cloud are not supported deployment targets today.
